paragraphs.text: Necron is a creature type introduced for the crossover Warhammer 40,000 . It is used to represent an alien species of androids from the earliest days of the galaxy.
Necron is a Warhammer 40K crossover type.

Necrons comprise a completely robotic humanoid species whose technological prowess is unmatched by any of the other intelligent species of the galaxy. The original Necron race gave up their organic forms for immortal robotic ones and in the process lost all forms of compassion and empathy. Their machine forms allow them to repair and rebuild themselves when destroyed.
